presentation.title: SolarSound Presentation
presentation.subtitle: Discover why SolarSound is one of the best music players on PC
presentation.intro: SolarSound was created to meet a personal need: listening to music in 5.1 surround sound with precise adjustment options. Not finding a satisfactory solution in existing software like VLC, I decided to create my own player. Today this project has taken on a much larger dimension, also offering itself as an innovative music player if you listen to music from discs or mp3 (or WAV obviously for purists)

story.title: My Story
story.content: I am passionate about music, engineering and use computers a lot. This project started as a simple personal experiment. Today, it has become a complete media player with advanced features for audio and video playback. Everything is developed in Python, with the help of AI, but always with attention to detail and quality.

technology.title: Technologies Used
technology.content: SolarSound uses PyQt6 for its graphical interface, with specialized audio libraries such as sounddevice, soundfile, and mutagen for multimedia file management. The interface is fully customizable with color themes and adaptable fonts.

future.title: Project Future
future.content: I am constantly working on new features: support for more formats, improved audio effects, more intuitive interface, and cross-platform support. Your feedback is welcome to guide development.

customizable.title: Customizable Interface
customizable.description: Change colors, fonts, and arrange the interface according to your preferences.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.description: Interface available in French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Russian and more.

performance.title: Optimized Performance
performance.description: Smooth playback even with large playlists and high-resolution files.

videoPlayer.title: Video Player
videoPlayer.description: Watch videos or even movies with this integrated player, it supports media with surround sound obviously
